أصطخب (form VIII)
# أَصْطَخِبُ (ʔaṣṭaḵibu) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.xi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# أُصْطَخَبُ (ʔuṣṭaḵabu) /ʔusˤ.tˤa.xa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# أَصْطَخِبَ (ʔaṣṭaḵiba) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.xi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# أُصْطَخَبَ (ʔuṣṭaḵaba) /ʔus
